name: voicechat-monorepo
//: desktop и agent-tray НЕ в workspaces намеренно: у них свой node_modules с Electron — корневой npm install их не трогает.

scripts.test: node --test scripts/affected-check.test.mjs scripts/frontend-quality.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.frontend:typecheck: npm run -w @voicechat/ui-kit typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-core typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/profile-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/app-shell typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/chat-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/web-reader-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/playwright-reader-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/projects-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/operations-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/admin-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/ui typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/web typecheck && npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck:web
scripts.frontend:test: npm run -w @voicechat/ui-kit test && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-core test && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/profile-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/app-shell test && npm run -w @voicechat/chat-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/web-reader-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/playwright-reader-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/projects-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/operations-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/admin-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/ui test && npm run -w @voicechat/web test
scripts.frontend:build-gates: npm run -w @voicechat/web build && node scripts/frontend-quality.mjs --bundle && npm run build:storybook && npm ci --prefix apps/desktop && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run frontend:static && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build-gates
scripts.//storybook: Смоук-сборка витрины: единственное, что ловит сломанную сториз — tsc её JSX проверяет, а рендер нет.
scripts.//test:storybook: Фолбэк Component QA при пустой настройке test_command: смоук-сборка Storybook.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:storybook && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run test:desktop && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm run typecheck:agent-tray && npm run test:agent-tray
scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run -w @voicechat/web build && npm run build:storybook
